title: GHAR FATIMA KA LUT GAYA
body:
Maatam karo ahle Aza
Hai aasmano par buka
Karte hain Maatam Ambia
Hain sar barahna Mustafa
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ke Wo Noor e Nazar
Jab chal base donon Pisar
Maa ka jigar Sajde me Sar
Rone lage Shaahe Huda
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Tukde Hasan ke Laala ke
Maqtal me the bikhre huwe
Ab Laash ye kaise uthe
Sarwar bichhaate hain abaa
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kubra ki haay zindagi
Dulhan bani bewa huwi
Kya keh ke ro'e bekasi
Hamsin waha'n koi nahi
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Laila ka aur Shabbir ka
Kadiyal Jawaa'n farzand tha
Barchchi se dil Uska chhida
Jalti zamee'n par Sogaya
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Ummul Banee'n ka Wo Pisar
Be dast Ghaazi khoo'n me tar
Kaise gira Wo khaak par
Girya kuna'n hain Fatima
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar Fatima ke Laal ka
Jab hogaya tann se juda
Deti rahi Zainab sada
Paamaal Laasha hogaya
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Aage yunhi badhte raho
Maatam yunhi karte raho
Nauha yunhi padhte raho
Binte Ali Dengi Dua
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Maatam karo Abbas ka
Tum ko milega ye sila
Aankho'n me rakho Karbala
Behte rahein Ashk e Aza
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Parwaana e Shabbir ka
Abbas Tu hai Aasraa
Milti rahe unko sada
Bas Tere Parcham ki Hawa
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo bekaso'n ka Karwa'n
Beemaar Abid Naatawa'n
Wo Taugq aur wo bediya'n
Wo taaziaano'n ki jafa
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Be chaadari be chainiya'n
Mushkil kusha ki Betiya'n
Aur baazuo'n me reesma'n
Zanjeer me Zainul Aba
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas saqqaa'e Haram
Haq ka nasha'n Jis ka Alam
Jis ki wafa Dee'n ka bharam
BhaiWo Sheh ka Baawafa
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Haatho'n pa apne Baap ke
Magtal ko Asghar jab gaye
Ahle Sitam rone lage
Wo teer kha kar hans pada
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
The muztarib rann me Hussain
Ro ro ke karte the ye bain
Kis tarha aaye dil ko chain
Maa se kahein ab jaake kya
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Durre tamaache seliyaa'n
Mazloom Bachhi ki fughaa'n
Chheeni gayi hain baaliyaa'n
Kaano se khoo'n behta raha
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir Aye Jaane Batool
Lafzon ko de qadmon ki Dhool
Nauha ye Tu karle Qubool
Ezaaz ye karde Ataa
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab hain Rasheed ashkon ke bain
Aye Fatima ke Noor e Ain
De dil ko Chain ab Ya Hussain
Pohnchade hamko Karbala
<<MINI>>
Ghar Fatima ka lut gaya
author: Rasheed Shaheedi
